summary: Implemented support for total=None in Rich Progress. Changes: rich/progress.py (Task.total/remaining/time_remaining Optional-aware; advance/update skip auto-finish when total is None; BarColumn pulses when total is None; TotalFileSizeColumn shows "?"; MofNCompleteColumn and DownloadColumn show only the completed amount; add_task signature widened), rich/progress_bar.py (ProgressBar accepts total=None and pulses; percentage_completed returns 0.0), tests/test_progress.py (new test test_total_none_renders_pulse_and_no_eta), CHANGELOG.md (Unreleased entry). Progress tests pass (37/37). Full suite: tests/test_pretty.py fails at collection both before and after changes; the other 13 failures are identical before and after my changes. Nothing committed.
